company: Internship List
title: Software Developer Intern, MyAdmin (Winter/January 2027, 8+ Months)
location: Oakville, Ontario - Canada; Waterloo, Ontario - Canada
field: -
description:
[under: How we work] At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work.
[under: How we work] However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like.
[under: How we work] When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL.

company: Palo Alto Networks, Inc.
title: Principal Software Engineer (C++-low level-Prisma Browser)
location: Office - USA - CA - Headquarters
field: -
description:
[under: Who We Are] We believe collaboration thrives in person.
[under: Who We Are] That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed.
[under: Job Summary] You will work across Chromium, operating systems, networking, security, and remote-access technologies, rapidly learning unfamiliar systems and turning research and prototypes into secure, production-quality capabilities.
[under: Preferred Qualifications] - Experience with RDP, SSH, SMB, VNC, VDI, application streaming, remote browser isolation, or other remote-access technologies.

company: Sidley Austin LLP (IL LLP)
title: User Support Analyst
location: Century City
field: -
description:
[under: Duties and Responsibilities] - Hardware Support functions include, but are not limited to, end user support, desktop support, laptop support, visiting office setups, and mobile device support. Perform computer imaging and post image configurations, preventative maintenance, and basic printer troubleshooting working with the vendor on repairs.
[under: Duties and Responsibilities] - Assist with projects such hardware or software upgrades, office moves and special events.
[under: Required] - Experience supporting Microsoft Office Applications and Remote Access technology, such as Citrix
[under: Preferred] - A+, ITIL and Microsoft Office Application certifications
